meta.title: Tesuch — whenever an inspector comes, you’re ready
meta.description: Tesuch keeps your business ready for a labour inspection: one status, at most three tasks a week and an “Inspector is here” pack. Employees are stored as codes, not names.

hero.title: Whenever an inspector comes, you’re ready.
hero.subtitle: Tesuch checks your staff contracts every night and shows one clear status: No known issues, Needs attention or Risk. Each week you get at most three tasks, and one button builds the pack you need when an inspector is at the door.
hero.ctaCheck: Check your staff file for free
hero.note: No sign-up · the file never leaves your device

stats.euHint: data stored in an EU region

steps.d: Upload an Excel or CSV file, or enter people by hand. Columns are recognised automatically, and employees are stored as codes such as EMP-014, not names.
Every night the rules go through each contract and calculate the deadlines. You have nothing to remember.
Open your home page, see one status and do at most three tasks a week. A Telegram message and an email warn you when something is due.

home.title: One status. Three tasks. One button.
home.desc: Open Tesuch and in five seconds you know where you stand. No reports to read.

statuses.d: Nothing urgent in what Tesuch checks. Not a guarantee of the inspection result.
A few things should be fixed before an inspector comes.
Fix these first: an inspector could find serious gaps today.

tasks.d: Only the most urgent things, in plain language, with the source of the rule. Not a list of fifty.

pack.d: One tap builds a checklist and the list of documents to have ready, as a PDF.

home.note: We do not predict when an inspector will come. Nobody can. We keep you ready for whenever it happens.

done.title: We can do it for you
done.desc: You do not have to set anything up yourself.
points: Send us one staff file and the Tesuch team imports it.
Or let your accounting firm set it up, and you only read the weekly message.
Only minimal data is needed: codes and dates.

codes.title: Codes instead of names
codes.desc: Tesuch stores employees as codes such as EMP-014. Names are optional and switched off for new businesses. We keep only the dates the rules need, and never documents, salaries or passport data.
points: Even if someone broke in, they would find codes and dates, not people.
The free file check runs in your browser: the file is never uploaded.
No system can promise it will never be hacked, so we keep as little as possible.

owners.title: One message a week
owners.desc: Every Monday a short Telegram message with one to three concrete steps. No need to read the Labour Code.
tgLines: Probation ends in 5 days — decide whether to confirm
owners.tgFooter: Advisory: not yet verified by a lawyer

firms.title: Do you keep the books for several businesses?
firms.desc: Tesuch also has a firm dashboard: every client in one list with its status, the riskiest on top. It is an advanced mode of the same product, and your clients get the same weekly message.

trust.title: Why you can trust it

items.d: Every check is written as a versioned rule and covered by tests. The same data always gives the same result.
Every alert names its source and links to arlis.am.
All rules are still being reviewed by a lawyer, so they show as “Advisory”. We never invent article numbers.
The database runs in a European Union region. We keep only what the rules need: codes and dates.
Each business sees only its own data. This is enforced in the database itself and verified by automated tests.

trust.status: {n, plural, one {# rule} other {# rules}} · all in lawyer review

items.a: No. Tesuch is an information tool. It shows risks and points to the law, but talk to a lawyer before you decide. Rules a lawyer hasn't verified yet are marked “Advisory”.

items.q: Can you tell me when an inspector will come?
items.a: No. Nobody can predict that, and Tesuch never claims to. It keeps you ready for whenever an inspector comes.

Employees as codes such as EMP-014, plus the dates the rules need: contract type and dates, probation end, leave, and date of birth for the minors rule. Names are optional and off for new businesses. We do not store documents, salaries, passport data, addresses or phone numbers.

items.q: We already use ArmSoft. Why Tesuch?
items.a: ArmSoft stores your HR records; Tesuch checks them against the law and warns you before deadlines. You can import staff from an ArmSoft CSV or Excel export.
Pricing isn't set yet. We're choosing the first pilot firms now — leave your email after the self-check.

cta.title: See where you stand in two minutes
cta.desc: Open your staff file here and get a status straight away. Nothing is uploaded.

footer.disclaimer: Tesuch is an information tool, not legal advice. Rules marked “Advisory” have not yet been verified by a lawyer. Before making a decision, consult a lawyer and check the current text of the law on arlis.am.
